payload.text: **ST0007 design v0.2 at 81f72ee, with vc for review** (v0.1 at 4b246b2 is superseded). hv ruled v0.1's four questions on 2026-09-16: no CI gate before the tag (fail forward; ci.query reports after); a top-level builtin 'release <--patch|--minor|--major|vX.Y.Z>' in the fleet's existing spelling; every release: key defaulted and overridable; no project a special case (Conflab and Intent adopt like Utilz and devbin; only Intentv2 out). ACs are proposed in the design, to mint after vc's review. 3 questions wait on utilz-cc.
